_comment: Wave 1 landing pages (English). slug = public unlisted address: https://www.ivinfotech.com/campaign/<slug> (same route as the pilot page; built by build_site_pages.py and deployed with agent/deploy/vps_site_pages.sh). build_pages.py alone makes the standalone copy (console /p/<slug>, not used for hosting). Edit the texts here, then rebuild. The flags are OWNER DECISIONS, change them here only.
demo_what: WhatsApp opens with a ready message. Press Send, and we reply with a short sample of this chat for {PROJECT}, from our own number. Nothing is connected to your number or your ads. We keep your number and message only to send the demo. A call happens only if you ask for one.

leads.hook: Many of the Pride Aura ads we saw have a Send WhatsApp message button. Here is how each message can get an automatic reply in about a minute.
